query: /* select#1 */ select straight_join `dbide_test_probe`.`trees`.`id` AS `id`,`dbide_test_probe`.`trees`.`name` AS `name`,`dbide_test_probe`.`leaves`.`id` AS `id`,`dbide_test_probe`.`leaves`.`tree_id` AS `tree_id` from `dbide_test_probe`.`trees` join `dbide_test_probe`.`leaves` FORCE INDEX (`tree_idx`) where (`dbide_test_probe`.`leaves`.`tree_id` = `dbide_test_probe`.`trees`.`id`)

inputs.operation: Covering index lookup on leaves using tree_idx (tree_id=trees.id)
